title: The completed configuration space has a global Coulomb slice and proper residual quotient

coulomb_quotient.bundle_scope: The repository control uses the trivial Abelian bundle on T3 and the connected triangular-domain gauge group
coulomb_quotient.hodge_solve: For every spatial connection A, the unique mean-zero chi_0 solving Delta chi_0=-div A sends A to div A_C=0
coulomb_quotient.based_uniqueness: Two Coulomb representatives related by a mean-zero gauge function differ by harmonic chi_0, hence chi_0=0
coulomb_quotient.residual_group: The remaining transformations are constant compact U(1), acting strongly continuously by phi mapsto exp(i e c Q)phi while leaving A_C fixed
coulomb_quotient.properness: A continuous action of compact U(1) is proper; therefore the Coulomb slice modulo residual U(1) is Hausdorff and the orbit projection is closed
coulomb_quotient.triangular_compatibility: K1394's combined derivative-plus-charge estimate makes the slice change and residual action bounded automorphisms of every finite triangular tier
coulomb_quotient.energy_descent: The positive repository energy and closed Gauss surface are gauge invariant and descend to the classical quotient
coulomb_quotient.boundary: This is a global classical configuration/constraint quotient for the repository model, not a source-selected observed-state space, BFV boundary phase space or Hilbert cohomology
